purpose: Verify previously reported exploratory numerical findings and evaluate the same fixed comparisons across all nine existing test quarters.
status: Exploratory retrospective analysis of previously examined data; not a new untouched validation set.
fit: For candidate quarter t: fit on candidate quarters before t-1, calibrate on t-1, predict t; outcome is t+1.
history: Any threshold crossing in available history strictly before t; history begins 2022Q1.
models: Fresh project logistic and histogram gradient boosting fits with unchanged parameters and seed 42.
baselines: Any earlier crossing then current proximity
metrics: average precision (independent tied-score implementation and sklearn cross-check)
top 100/250/500 yield and tie-aware expected yield
50% and 80% capture workload with tie-aware expectation and bounds
subgroup AP among prior-crossing versus no-prior-crossing candidates
not_tested: formal independent significance or dependence-aware confidence intervals
